build_notes:
Leveling 1-12 (still probably best way to level)
	Splitting Steel, Chance to Bleed

Leveling 12+
	Sunder until Boneshatter SWAP

NOTABLE 3.21 CHANGES
	-determination reservation gone, this requires us to grab a mana mastery - which is relevry, this has 10% aura effect for our Pride aura as well.
	**OR USE ARROGANCE PRECISION INSTEAD**

	-new 1% max res armour mastery with armour on all gear (hybrid armor/eva is the gear we're aiming for anyways for suppression)
	-suppression mastery moved to evasion mastery and requires at least a hybrid chest on (this build already ran hybrid EVA/ARM for suppression though)
	-physical impale mastery gone, but new 10% more maximum physical damage mastery makes up for it (net buff? probably)

MOLTEN SHELL nerf
	-not much to talk about still the best guard skill by far.

STANCE DANCING
	-we are quite close to Dance of Blades, this would net us onslaught and adrenaline with Blood and Sand on left click, I opted to not put this in the POB since it might be changed before the patch but I figured I would mention it here.

SUPPRESION VS NO SUPPRESSION
	-you can technically run pure armour and go for max res (brass dome is huge) and skip suppression for more damage, this is an option but I prefer suppression still personally (more damage because you save points)

PANOPTICON
	-this a huge node for bossing, totems make up a lot of damage between buffs and actual hits, this tree does not have it since its a mapping tree - definitely an option though!

CRUCIBLE PROBABLY HUGE POWER CREEP FOR THIS BUILD!
